briefing.headline: OpenAI Orion-2 and xAI Colossus-3 escalate multi-agent reasoning race

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs released 9 new models in June amid $14.2B quarterly funding. Multi-agent systems now dominate benchmarks while regulatory pressure mounts on autonomous agents.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deployed Orion-2 with 2.3T parameters achieving 94% on GAIA. Anthropic Claude 5 Opus and xAI Colossus-3 launched within 48 hours, focusing on long-horizon agentic tasks.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and BCI deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: Google and Microsoft activated 180k H200 clusters in new Texas and Arizona sites. TSMC 2nm AI chips entered volume production for 2027 delivery.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first multi-agent system to reach 95% on SWE-bench trigger a global pause agreement?
